description: Complete temporal context for a location: local time, timezone, 14-day calendar with day names and Today/Tomorrow offsets, sunrise/sunset/solar times (from the weather pipeline's astro product), and moon phase. Use whenever you need to reason about dates, times, or daylight for a location -- including "what time is sunset?", "is it dark there now?", or "what day of the week is the 4th-day forecast?". If current_time.timezone_resolved is false, zone unknown: state times as UTC, never as local. Accepts a place name directly. Example: {"location": "Seattle"}.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Most tools also accept a `location` place-name string instead of lat/lon.

location.description: Free-text place: city ("Denver"), city+state ("Portland, OR"), US ZIP ("50219"), or "lat,lon" ("39.74,-104.99"). Provide either this OR explicit lat+lon, not both.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). For continental US use negative values (west of the prime meridian).

name: get_time_context
title: Get time context
